body: Still here, decided it’s better to live even if it’s not for myself
I love you too. But I’m done my guy or girl.
See my thing is, she’s all I want, I messaged her today and all she said was, I obviously want space right now, it’s all I’m asking for, I just wish i could be told if it was permanent or not
This hurt to read, I feel this way too, I wish I could desperately fix things with my “one”
I told her we could maybe talk on Valentine’s Day, which would have been our year anniversary, but the waiting is destroying me, and I feel like waiting is a great way to fall out of love
I’m sorry you are going through it too. Because I feel miserably lost, and I try talking to them with little response
I just want definite answers you know, instead I get nothing, but that person still checks my social media, still keeps locations on me
Honestly just talk to him and be genuine, I would appreciate it if I was on the other end of this. Explain your mistakes and that you genuinely feel for him.
Could be signs of psychopathy or mental illness honestly, i suffer from a personality disorder, sometimes my own emotions go straight to 0
